title: How a Godly Man Runs His Impulses Before They Run Him
caption:
Proverbs calls it a city with broken walls. A man with no control over his spirit, wide open on every side.

Self-control isn't gritting your teeth harder in the moment. It's what you build before the moment ever shows up: naming the urge, putting real distance between you and the trigger, asking what it's actually pointing at underneath.

Confess your sins to one another, that you may be healed (James 5:16). What stays hidden keeps running you. Said out loud, it starts losing its grip.

#faith #selfcontrol #discipline #christianmen #godlyman #brotherhood
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
